{{External|rs|rsc=Yew Logs|dw=Yew Logs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Yew logs |image = [[File:Yew logs.png]] |release = [[25 March]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (25 March 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = Logs cut from a yew tree. |value = 160 |weight = 2.000 |exchange = Yes |id = 1515 }} [[File:Yew logs detail.png|130x130px|left]] '''Yew logs''' are logs obtained from cutting [[yew tree]]s, which require at least level 60 [[Woodcutting]] for players to cut. They give 175 [[experience]] when cut with an [[axe]]. Players can burn these logs with the [[Firemaking]] skill at level 60, granting 202.5 Firemaking experience. Yew logs can also be made into bows, stock, and arrow shafts using the [[Fletching]] skill. When the log is cut into a [[yew longbow (u)]] at level 70, it yields 75 experience. Cutting a [[yew shortbow (u)]] at level 65 will give 67.5 experience. Stringing the unstrung bows will give the same experience as for cutting them. One full inventory of yew logs gives 4,900 Woodcutting experience. Players would need to cut {{formatnum:{{Items Needed|Goal=99|Level=60|ItemXp=175}}}} yew logs to go from 60 to 99 Woodcutting. Yew logs can also be used to travel to [[Castle Wars]] on the [[Balloon transport system]], costing 10 logs on the initial trip, and 1 log for every trip following that. 6 yew logs can be used to light an [[Abyssal lantern (yew logs)|Abyssal lantern]], requiring 60 Firemaking. ==Skill info== {{Woodcutting info |name = Yew tree |level = 60 |xp = 175 |tree = [[Yew tree]] |tool = [[Axe]] |time = 59.4 seconds }} {{Firemaking info |version1 = Tinderbox |version2 = Bow |version3 = Barbarian pyre |version4 = Bonfire |skill2name = Crafting |name = Yew logs |skill1lvl1 = 60 |skill1lvl2 = 80 |pyrelevel = 70 |craftxp = 50.6 |skill1lvl3 = 70 |skill2lvl3 = 70 |skill1lvl4 = 60 |skill1exp1 = 202.5 |skill1exp2 = 202.5 |skill1exp3 = 202.5 |skill1exp4 = 202.5 |facility1 = N/A |facility2 = N/A |facility3 = [[Funeral pyre (Barbarian)|Barbarian funeral pyre]] |facility4 = [[Fire]] or [[Forester's Campfire]] |tool1 = [[Tinderbox]] |tool2 = [[Bow]] |tool3 = [[Tinderbox]] or [[bow]], and an [[axe]] |tool4 = N/A |type = logs }} ==Money making== {{Mmgsection|Cutting yew logs|Cutting yew logs (free-to-play)}} ==Experience from logs== *Each log gives 175 [[Woodcutting]] [[experience]] when cut (Woodcutting level 60 required). When wearing the full [[Lumberjack outfit]], each log gives 179.5 experience when cut. *Lighting a log gives 202.5 [[Firemaking]] experience (Firemaking level 60 required). *Making 75 [[arrow shafts]] gives 25 [[Fletching]] experience (Fletching level 60 required). *Making an [[Yew shortbow (u)|unstrung yew shortbow]] gives 67.5 [[Fletching]] experience and 67.5 additional experience when adding [[bow string]] (Fletching level 65 required). *Making an [[Yew longbow (u)|unstrung yew longbow]] gives 75 Fletching experience and 75 additional experience when adding bow string (Fletching level 70 required). *Making a full [[yew stock]] gives 50 Fletching experience (Fletching level 69 required). *Making a [[yew shield]] requires two logs and gives 150 Fletching experience, or 75 experience per log (Fletching level 72 required). ==Products== {{Uses material list|Yew logs}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Yew logs}} ==Treasure Trails== *{{SherlockChallenge|Cutting yew logs|elite}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 11 July 2005 |update = Farming |change = The item was graphically updated with the release of [[Farming]]. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Yew logs detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Yew logs detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Yew logs detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Yew logs (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Yew logs (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Yew logs.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
